sloka: सदृशम् राज शार्दूल तव एव भुवि न अन्यतः ।महावंश प्रसूतस्य वसिष्ठ व्यपदेशिनः ॥१-१९-२॥
transliteration: sadṛśam rāja śārdūla tava eva bhuvi na anyataḥ ।mahāvaṁśa prasūtasya vasiṣṭha vyapadeśinaḥ ॥1-19-2॥

translations.english: "O Tiger among kings having been born on earth in an illustrious lineage and initiated by Vasishta, this way (of speaking) befits you. It cannot be any other way.
translations.hindi: महाराज भी यज्ञदीक्षा के नियमों को समाप्त कर, रानियों,.. सेवकों, सेना और वाहनों सहित राजधानी में चले गये
